title: ACID Properties in Relational Databases
realWorldScenario: A user is transferring $100 from Account A to Account B. A power outage occurs after Account A is debited but before Account B is credited.
questionStatement: Explain the ACID properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) in relational databases. How does ACID protect the bank transfer scenario?
hints: Map each letter of ACID to how the money transfer is handled.
